goal: Compiling a selected finding through the headless authoring agent emits one or more flywheel tasks that each load as a valid core Task with at least one grader whose authoritative check is a pre-existing repo command or a registered held-out oracle (never a check the same emitted task's own diff would create), while a finding that cannot be compiled to a grader-bearing task is dropped with a recorded reason instead of written.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00058-FEATURE-autopilot-mvp.md -- acceptance criteria #1, #8, the verification-surface DoD, and decision D-2 this task satisfies; this is the integrity crux of the phase
docs/task-schema.md -- the Task/Grader shape every emitted task must satisfy; a grader needs a real runnable check
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/loaders.py -- load_task_file is the authoritative validator; every emitted task file must load through it without error (this is criterion #1's grader)
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_autopilot.py -- import the Finding shape from autopilot-discovery; the authoring step consumes a selected finding

packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/invoker.py -- drive the authoring agent through the same injectable invoker seam autopilot-discovery established, so the test scripts authoring deterministically

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_skill_templates/fw-spec.md -- the authoring contract the agent follows headlessly: ungameable end-state criteria; ambiguity a human would be asked is resolved as a RECORDED ASSUMPTION, never by emitting a vaguer task

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_skill_templates/fw-plan.md -- the grader-ladder contract: prefer an out-of-band command grader that points at a committed repo check; the executing agent must not author its own authoritative grade
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_held_out_gate.py -- precedent for held-out oracles registered out of the agent's reach; a held-out check is an acceptable authoritative grader source
constraints: The authoritative grader on an emitted task MUST be either (a) a command that invokes a check already committed in the target repo, or (b) a registered held-out oracle -- never a grader whose target file is created by the same emitted task's own diff. The test asserts this grader-source property directly (criterion #8); a self-authored grader emission must fail.

Every emitted task file MUST load via flywheel_core.loaders.load_task_file and have a non-empty graders array (criterion #1). A finding that cannot be lowered to such a task is DROPPED with a recorded reason and NOT written -- a goal-only or grader-less file is never emitted.

Ambiguity resolution is fully headless (D-2): the authoring agent records assumptions rather than asking, and never narrows a task to a vaguer one to dodge an unresolved question. Resolved assumptions are recorded with the emitted task, not edited into the spec.
Authoring drives agents only through the injectable invoker seam; the test uses a scripted invoker, no live model.
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do NOT write tasks into the live work source or run the worker here -- emit task objects/files the test inspects; wiring emission into the refill loop and the run source is autopilot-loop.
Do NOT introduce a new Grader type or any flywheel-core schema change -- compose existing grader types only.
Do NOT let the authoring path emit a task whose only grader is a brand-new test the executing agent would write to pass itself -- that is the exact self-attestation #8 forbids.
Do NOT modify files under tests/ other than adding this task's new tests; do not weaken or delete existing assertions.
edge_cases: A finding with no expressible out-of-band grader is dropped with a recorded reason -- a test that lets it be written as a grader-less task must fail.
An emitted task whose grader command names a file that the same task's diff creates must be rejected by the authoring path (self-attestation guard).
A single finding may legitimately compile to more than one task (chained via prerequisites); each emitted task still independently satisfies criteria #1 and #8.
Every emitted file round-trips through load_task_file; a file that parses as JSON but fails Task validation must fail the grader.
